boundaries.scope: Exact-splice helper quantified source-level proof with valid memory and provider assumptions
Witness validation and modular C99 wrapper WP; SHA provider remains assumed
Actual OpenSSL wrapper positive and injected negative executions, not unbounded EVP correctness
OpenSSL NIST parity and opt-in pinned HACL*; upstream proof does not certify this adapter
Actual receipt parser modular WP and bounded CBMC; no complete receipt/chain theorem
Measured native C/Rust ABI sizes and failure outputs on target matrix; ownership proof remains open
Two identical repeat-build binaries per target/compiler/backend; compiler correctness unproved
OS, firmware, CPU, physical memory, time, entropy and failure-free hardware remain environmental premises
Historical deletion, author, trusted chronology, independent anchor custody and secure erasure require evidence outside TOMBSTONE

chain_head_anchor.format: 64 lowercase sha256 hex bytes with optional final LF
chain_head_anchor.used_by: Rust CLI forwards 32 raw bytes to authoritative C99 verify_chain
chain_head_anchor.proves: equality to caller-supplied retained value, conditional on integrity/custody

physical_event_classes.evidence: caller-provided before/removed/after buffers and offset, C99 checked
separately collected OS/filesystem audit or independent witness
device-specific controller/storage/forensic evidence independent of this tool

prohibited_claims: verified machine code from repeat-build hashes
excluded_evidence: No private plaintext, file paths, identity data or user anchors embedded
No private key or certificate provisioned; no signature-verification claim
No claim that a local anchor file establishes independent external custody
